selection_policy: No hardware selected, parameter identified or device integrated in S0.

dependencies.missing_information: Identified dimensions, CG, mass/inertia and load ranges; bounded errors
dependencies.current_limit: Synthetic parameters and center corridor do not identify the hardware.
dependencies.required_evidence: Independent measurement/calibration with configurations and uncertainty

dependencies.missing_information: Axle forces, combined grip, load/temperature/surface dependence and uncertainty
dependencies.current_limit: Synthetic smooth grip law is not hardware validation.
dependencies.required_evidence: Bench and controlled-envelope identification, including lateral/longitudinal coupling

dependencies.missing_information: Force/torque/steering limits, lag, slew, deadband, actual wheel allocation and feedback
dependencies.current_limit: Synthetic a_cmd=-3 is not measured deceleration; rear-wheel motor drag differs from normal-load-proportional allocation.
dependencies.required_evidence: Actuator/subsystem characterization under load, saturation, reverse energy and faults

dependencies.missing_information: IMU/wheel/localization capture timing, bias, uncertainty sets, dropout and frame consistency
dependencies.current_limit: Perfect-state simulation supplies no fault-tolerant estimation.
dependencies.required_evidence: Calibrated independent reference and dropout/common-mode fault trials

dependencies.missing_information: Clock relation, drift/reset bounds, scheduling and worst-case detection/decision/actuation timing within declared conditions
dependencies.current_limit: Mac SINGLE averages/tails are not target real-time bounds.
dependencies.required_evidence: Timestamped target instrumentation and overload/clock reset tests

dependencies.missing_information: Integrity, sequencing, cancellation/ack behavior, queue bounds, one-way loss and timeout semantics
dependencies.current_limit: No validated host/MCU command transport exists here.

dependencies.missing_information: Independence from supervised CPU, clocks, software and relevant power faults; local enforcement
dependencies.current_limit: A host loop or logging heartbeat alone is not an independent watchdog.
dependencies.required_evidence: Fault tree, crash/deadlock/false-heartbeat tests, independent e-stop tests

dependencies.missing_information: Battery range, brownout, residual energy, motor/brake/steering state on power loss and reboot
dependencies.current_limit: Power-off is not automatically braking or safe steering.
dependencies.required_evidence: Controlled fault/power tests and mechanical/electrical review

dependencies.missing_information: Footprint, obstacles, corridor/map registration, surface and slope envelope
dependencies.current_limit: Recorded center clearance is not continuous collision certification.
dependencies.required_evidence: Independent geometry validation and swept-envelope experiments

dependencies.missing_information: Validated transition below dynamic vx=0.5 m/s, standstill/rest detection, stopping distance/time and holding behavior
dependencies.current_limit: Current dynamic model has no valid stop-to-zero transition.
dependencies.required_evidence: Separately reviewed model and subsystem/HIL then physical stop tests
